Description: Caster gains double normal hearing. This results in +50 to Perception involving only hearing, +25 to Perception involving hearing and other senses.
Caster can see 100' on a normal night as if it were daylight. See Section 7.1.19.
Caster has a 300° field of vision. The flank bonus for attacks against the caster is lowered to +5 and the rear bonus are lowered to +15.
Caster gains an extremely acute sense of smell. This results in +50 to Perception involving only smell, +25 to Perception involving smell and other senses.
Caster can see 100' in any water (including murky water) as if it were daylight.
Caster can see 100' in any precipitation (including thick fog) as if it were daylight.
Caster gains extreme tactile sensitivity. This results in a +25 to all actions that depend on the tactile sense (e.g., pick locks, disarm traps, etc.).
As Nightvision, except any darkness can be seen through. Also, no light is needed for this spell to work.
Detects any invisible object in the area of effect. Caster can concentrate on a different 5'R each round.
Caster can check one object or place (up to 5'R) and tell if is an illusion or has an illusion on it.
As Scent, except caster can detect extremely faint scents (e.g., up to 48 hours old, after rain storms, through snow, etc.).
One illusion within the area of effect ceases to exist for the caster only.
As Touch, except bonus is +50.
Caster can see through wood (up to 1' per level).
Caster can see all invisible things anywhere that he can normally see. In addition, he suffers no penalties against invisible targets (as they are not invisible to him).
As any of the lower level Vision spells on this list but without a range limit (i.e., they will allow the caster to see anywhere he could normally see).
Caster cannot see any visual illusions. This does not affect any of the other senses.
As Woodsight, except stone can be seen through.
As all lower level Vision spells functioning at the same time.
As Woodsight, except iron (or steel) can be seen through.
As Woodsight, except any metal can be seen through.
Caster can use any one of the lower level spells (on this list) each round.
